assertions.claim: For a fallen elderly person: squat, call out, call 120, don't rush to lift them.
assertions.cn_span: 先蹲下喊他、打 120，别急着把人扶起来

assertions.claim: For a stranger walking away is legal; if you stop, do not move the person.
assertions.cn_span: 陌生人这档走开也合法，停下来就别上手搬

assertions.claim: Falls are the No.1 cause of injury death in people over 65; the person may have stroked or fainted before falling.
assertions.cn_span: 跌倒是 65 岁以上老人受伤死亡的头号原因

assertions.claim: If they don't remember how they fell, it may have been syncope or a cerebrovascular accident.
assertions.cn_span: 想不起来就可能是晕厥或者脑血管意外

assertions.claim: Forcing them up may worsen cerebral hemorrhage or ischemia; back pain/incontinence/fracture signs — don't move without expertise.
assertions.cn_span: 硬扶可能加重脑出血或脑缺血

assertions.claim: If it was you who hit them, burden of proof is on the claimant; the party without evidence bears adverse consequences.
assertions.cn_span: 谁主张谁举证，拿不出证据的一方自己承担不利后果

assertions.claim: In the SPC typical case the rescuer broke ribs and was sued for over 9,000 yuan; the court ruled no liability (RU 'Эффект' also names the pharmacy worker/18 days).
assertions.cn_span: 被索赔九千多，法院判不用赔

assertions.claim: You have no duty to rescue a stranger; stopping costs time, leaving your number, being contacted by family, defendant status, workplace scandal, being filmed and spread online.
Exception: operators/managers/organizers bear a safety obligation under Civil Code art. 1198 and cannot walk away for free.
assertions.cn_span: 你若是这个场所的经营者、管理者或者活动组织者，走开就不再免费
